title: Egyptian Antiquities and Italy
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This volume brings together the contributions presented at a conference on the subject of Egyptian antiquities and, more generally, on research conducted in Italy on topics related to pharaonic culture. The meeting of different competences was able to highlight the multiplicity and, at the same time, the interaction of disciplines that are often distant from each other, but which are united by their relationship with that abstract concept of cultural heritage that constitutes one of the central themes of the current debate on memory and identity
